engine: native C compiler; production main.c, format.c and metadata.c; mocked ESP-IDF APIs
limits: Deterministic control-flow shims; no real FreeRTOS scheduler, concurrent cores or ISR execution
EMG/IMU records are injected through production enqueue; sensor acquisition is tested separately
No physical SDMMC, flash persistence, radio transport, noise, power or runtime measurements
Late sync/close failures can leave an END marker among visible bytes; END alone cannot certify durability

foot.fit_note: needs at least 40 FIFO reads spanning 10 s

quality.imu_clock_note: Screen only: FIFO timestamp increments versus the recorded nominal tick (imu_timestamp_tick_us), and sensor ticks versus ESP32 interrupt times. Includes interrupt latency; not a calibration.
quality.timing_note: IMU host timestamps are estimates. Internal clock drift and sensor/analog filter delays are uncorrected.
quality.recovery_note: Timestamp unwrapping is ambiguous across long gaps; never infer missing cycles after corruption.
